findings.title: Stage order is checked only at the ends
findings.detail: Spec R4 is satisfied by asserting order[0] and order[-1], but CANONICAL_ORDER requires the whole sequence to be a subsequence. A blueprint with a legal first and last stage and a scrambled middle would pass. blueprint.load already rejects that, so this is coverage overlap rather than a hole.

findings.title: BLUEPRINTS is computed at import time
findings.detail: Collection happens once per session, so a blueprint added during a run is not seen. That is the intended behaviour for parametrize; noting it so the next reader does not treat it as a bug.

findings.title: The ttl assertion skips gate-less lines
findings.detail: `if bp.gates:` means a line with no gates asserts nothing. Correct today, since ttl_s has its own floor, but an explicit assert on the floor would read better.

findings.title: Duplicate-name message could name the offenders
findings.detail: Printing only the full list makes a 5-line diff harder to read than printing the duplicates themselves.
